settings.question: What makes Glass Labworks different?
settings.answer: We combine science-backed ingredients with thoughtful formulations designed to support healthier-looking skin and hair.

settings.question: How do I know which products are right for me?
settings.answer: Start with your primary concern and choose products formulated for that goal.

settings.question: Can I use Glass Labworks products every day?
settings.answer: Most routines are designed for daily use. Follow the directions on each product for best results.

settings.question: Are Glass Labworks products suitable for all skin and hair types?
settings.answer: Our formulas are developed for a wide range of skin and hair types. Patch test if you have sensitivities.

settings.question: How long does it take to see results?
settings.answer: Results vary by product and routine. Many customers notice improvements within a few weeks of consistent use.
